sections.project_overview: Transformation of the historic Beatties department store in Wolverhampton into a mixed-use development.

heritage_preservation.description: Sensitive restoration of the 1877 Art Deco façade and convex corner.
heritage_preservation.goal: Maintain the building as a historic anchor for the high street.

sustainability.benefit: Retention of existing structures to reduce embodied carbon

urban_design.connectivity: Pedestrian link between Victoria Street and School Street

public_realm.purpose: Provide green space and enhance resident wellbeing

community_impact.model: Integrated living, working, and social environment
